## Summary

Alder Mews Architects (policy CC-1518): accidental drop during transport of a tablet and a drawing display at a hotel meeting room in Leeds. Covered under clause 4.5, subject to one point to confirm on the carrier (see Coverage analysis); reserve 3,642 dollars.

## Facts

Alder Mews Architects reported the loss on 25 June 2026 [notice of loss]. The loss occurred at a hotel meeting room in Leeds [notice of loss]. The loss was an accidental drop during transport of a tablet and a drawing display [notice of loss], [incident report]. The incident was recorded on 27 June 2026 under reference IR/2026/4182 [incident report]. No third party was involved [incident report]. The items are a tablet (2,018 dollars) and a drawing display (1,624 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No theft is alleged [notice of loss], [incident report]. The file does not state who was carrying the items or between which premises [notice of loss], [incident report].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.5 of the policy, which covers accidental loss of or damage to portable equipment while being carried by an employee between premises [policy]. The file records an accidental drop during transport of two portable items [incident report]. It does not name the person carrying them or the premises travelled between, so the "employee" and "between premises" elements of clause 4.5 are not documented in the file and should be confirmed before payment.

Exclusion 7.1 does not apply: it concerns theft of unattended portable equipment, and no theft is alleged [incident report], [policy]. Exclusion 7.3 does not apply: the loss is a single accidental drop, not gradual deterioration [incident report], [policy]. Exclusion 7.5 does not apply: it applies only where theft is alleged, and none is [incident report], [policy].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.5. The claim is accepted, with the carrier's status as an employee and the premises travelled between to be confirmed and noted on the file.

## Reserve

The reserve is 3,642 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (2,018 dollars and 1,624 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. Clause 9.1 deducts an excess only where the schedule shows one [policy]. The file shows no excess, so none is deducted [policy].
